audioInfo.description: Composable audio metadata. Attach to any media record representing audio content: standalone audio files, audio tracks in video, etc.

bitRate.description: Audio bitrate in bits per second.

numberOfSamples.description: Total number of audio samples. Enables sample-accurate alignment.

speakerCount.description: Number of distinct speakers (for spoken language data).

transcriptRef.description: AT-URI of a pub.layers.expression containing the transcript.

segmentationRef.description: AT-URI of a pub.layers.segmentation record structuring the transcript.

videoInfo.description: Composable video metadata. Attach to any media record representing video content.

frameRate.description: Frame rate scaled by 100 (e.g., 2997 = 29.97fps). Avoids floats.

bitRate.description: Video bitrate in bits per second.

scanType.description: Scan type. Affects frame extraction for annotation.

documentInfo.description: Composable document/image metadata. Attach to any media record representing scanned documents, manuscripts, printed text, or other page-based media for OCR/HTR annotation workflows.

dpi.description: Scanning resolution in dots per inch (300+ recommended for OCR).

pageCount.description: Number of pages in the document.

writingDirectionUri.description: AT-URI of the writing-direction definition node (typeDef of `writing-direction` at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Refines writingDirection; never replaces it.

writingDirection.description: Primary text direction slug (fallback when writingDirectionUri unavailable).

signalInfo.description: Composable metadata for a sampled time-series recording. Attach to any media record of kind signal or motion. Frequencies are millihertz because BIDS types SamplingFrequency as number and 512.03 Hz occurs; lengths are nanometres because iEEG contact localization is reported sub-millimetre; times are session-relative nanoseconds, never UTC-epoch, since 2^53 ns is about 104 days.

modalityUri.description: AT-URI of the modality definition node: a pub.layers.ontology.typeDef of the `modality` ontology at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub, or a pub.layers.graph.graphNode. The SAME node set is named by pub.layers.judgment.defs#recordingMethod.methodUri and pub.layers.catalog.defs#contentSummary.modalityUri. Each modality node reaches its carrier node by parentTypeRef, so media.kindUri is the parent rather than a synonym. Refines modality; never replaces it.

modality.description: Modality slug (fallback when modalityUri unavailable). Mirrors recordingMethod.method member for member, extended with the continuous physiological channels that vocabulary omits.

formatUri.description: AT-URI of the container format definition node (typeDef of `signal-format` at layers-acquisition.ontology.layers.pub).

format.description: Container format slug (fallback when formatUri unavailable). Names what a reader must open; mimeType names the wire type, which for most of these is application/octet-stream.

samplingFrequencyMilliHz.description: Nominal sampling frequency in millihertz (2048 Hz = 2048000). BIDS SamplingFrequency, REQUIRED in the EEG, MEG, iEEG and NIRS sidecars; NWB ElectricalSeries.rate.

channelCount.description: Total recorded channels. BIDS EEGChannelCount / MEGChannelCount / NIRSChannelCount. Authoritative when channels is not fully enumerated.

numberOfSamples.description: Total samples per channel. With samplingFrequencyMilliHz this makes pub.layers.defs#signalSpan sample anchoring exact.

recordingDurationNanos.description: BIDS RecordingDuration, given in seconds upstream.

recordingTypeUri.description: AT-URI of the recording continuity definition node.

recordingType.description: Recording continuity slug (fallback when recordingTypeUri unavailable). BIDS RecordingType, same three values.

epochLengthNanos.description: BIDS EpochLength. Absent for continuous recordings.

epochCount.description: Number of epochs, for epoched recordings.

powerLineFrequencyMilliHz.description: Mains frequency in millihertz (50000 or 60000). BIDS PowerLineFrequency, REQUIRED in every electrophysiology sidecar: no downstream filtering decision can be made without it.

referenceSchemeUri.description: AT-URI of the reference scheme definition node (typeDef of `eeg-reference-scheme`).

referenceScheme.description: Referencing scheme slug (fallback when referenceSchemeUri unavailable). BIDS EEGReference and iEEGReference are both REQUIRED and both free text upstream; typing the common cases while keeping referenceDescription for the rest is the improvement over the upstream string.

referenceSensor.description: The reference electrode, as an objectRef whose objectId names a sensors[] uuid in this record. Replaces a free-text channel name, which cannot be validated and cannot be detected as dangling.

groundSensor.description: The ground electrode. BIDS EEGGround / iEEGGround.

referenceDescription.description: Free-text reference detail for schemes the slug vocabulary cannot express. Carries BIDS EEGReference verbatim when it does not map.

placementSchemeUri.description: AT-URI of the electrode or sensor placement definition node (typeDef of `electrode-placement`).

placementScheme.description: Placement scheme slug (fallback when placementSchemeUri unavailable). BIDS EEGPlacementScheme, free text upstream.

filterStatusUri.description: AT-URI of the filter-reporting status definition node.

filterStatus.description: Whether filters is a complete account (fallback when filterStatusUri unavailable). BIDS makes SoftwareFilters REQUIRED and permits the literal n/a, which conflates none-applied with not-reported; separating them means an empty filters array is unambiguous.

filters.description: Filters in application order. Carries BIDS HardwareFilters and SoftwareFilters, arbitrary untyped JSON upstream, as a typed list so a consumer can decide admissibility without parsing prose.

channels.description: Per-channel table in acquisition order. BIDS channels.tsv, whose name, type and units columns are REQUIRED. Inline rather than one record per channel: getRepo bulk export is fast and unmetered while listRecords caps at 100 per page, and a montage is one logical object.

sensors.description: Physical sensor geometry. BIDS electrodes.tsv and optodes.tsv plus NWB's electrodes DynamicTable. Separate from channels because the two are not in bijection: an fNIRS channel is a source-detector-wavelength triple and a bipolar iEEG channel is a difference of two contacts.

coordinateSystem.description: Frame in which sensors coordinates are expressed. BIDS coordsystem.json.

device.description: Acquisition hardware. BIDS Manufacturer / ManufacturersModelName / DeviceSerialNumber / SoftwareVersions; NWB Device.

eventChannel.description: The trigger or stimulus-code channel, as an objectRef into this record's channels.

eventCodes.description: Trigger codes and their meanings. BIDS events.tsv carries trial_type as a bare string; grounding each code through a typeDef lets two labs' code 12 be recognized as the same condition or as different ones.

eventLayerRef.description: AT-URI of a pub.layers.annotation.annotationLayer of kind tier holding the decoded event stream. This is where BIDS events.tsv lands: onset and duration map to anchor.temporalSpan or anchor.signalSpan, trial_type to the layer subkind or the annotation label.

headCircumferenceNanometres.description: BIDS HeadCircumference, centimetres upstream. On the recording rather than the participant because it is measured at acquisition.

dewarPositionUri.description: AT-URI of the dewar position definition node.

dewarPosition.description: MEG dewar position slug (fallback when dewarPositionUri unavailable). BIDS DewarPosition, REQUIRED in the MEG sidecar.

digitizedLandmarks.description: BIDS DigitizedLandmarks, REQUIRED in the MEG sidecar.

digitizedHeadPoints.description: BIDS DigitizedHeadPoints, REQUIRED in the MEG sidecar.

associatedEmptyRoomRef.description: AT-URI of a pub.layers.media.media holding the empty-room noise recording. BIDS AssociatedEmptyRoom is a filesystem path; an AT-URI is the structured form of the same relation.

sourceOptodeCount.description: BIDS NIRSSourceOptodeCount, REQUIRED in the NIRS sidecar.

detectorOptodeCount.description: BIDS NIRSDetectorOptodeCount, REQUIRED in the NIRS sidecar.

cogAtlasRef.description: Cognitive Atlas term for the task. BIDS CogAtlasID is RECOMMENDED on every electrophysiology and behavioural sidecar. Use source cognitive-atlas.

features.description: Open-ended features not captured by the typed fields.

signalChannel.description: One recorded channel. BIDS channels.tsv, whose name, type and units columns are REQUIRED for every electrophysiology modality and which additionally makes low_cutoff and high_cutoff REQUIRED for iEEG. Position is held by reference through sensor, because channel and sensor are not in one-to-one correspondence.

uuid.description: Stable identifier for this channel within this record. Required because anchors, reference declarations and sync declarations point at channels, and a name or a positional index silently mis-addresses when a republished recording drops two bad channels.

name.description: Channel name exactly as in the raw file (Cz, MEG0113, S1-D1-760, gaze_x).

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the channel type definition node (typeDef of `channel-type` at layers-acquisition.ontology.layers.pub). The authoritative field: the union of the BIDS EEG, MEG, iEEG, NIRS and Motion keyword sets already runs to roughly sixty terms and grows with each extension proposal. The knownValues below are a seed, not a closed list.

type.description: Channel type slug (fallback when typeUri unavailable). Union of the BIDS keyword sets, uppercase as BIDS spells them.

unitUri.description: AT-URI of the physical unit definition node (typeDef of `si-unit`).

unit.description: Physical unit of this channel's samples (fallback when unitUri unavailable). BIDS channels.tsv units, REQUIRED, which expects SI units.

samplingFrequencyMilliHz.description: Per-channel rate when it differs from the recording's nominal rate, routine for auxiliary channels multiplexed into one file.

lowCutoffMilliHz.description: High-pass cutoff. 0 means DC-coupled. BIDS channels.tsv low_cutoff, a REQUIRED column for iEEG.

highCutoffMilliHz.description: Low-pass cutoff. BIDS channels.tsv high_cutoff, a REQUIRED column for iEEG.

statusUri.description: AT-URI of the channel status definition node.

status.description: Channel quality slug (fallback when statusUri unavailable). BIDS channels.tsv status.

statusDescription.description: Why the channel is bad or interpolated. BIDS channels.tsv status_description.

referenceChannel.description: Per-channel reference for bipolar and mixed intracranial montages. BIDS channels.tsv reference.

sensor.description: The sensors entry this channel reads from. How a channel acquires a position without duplicating coordinates per channel.

sourceSensor.description: Emitting optode. BIDS NIRS channels.tsv source, a REQUIRED column.

detectorSensor.description: Receiving optode. BIDS NIRS channels.tsv detector, a REQUIRED column.

wavelengthPicometres.description: Nominal wavelength (760 nm = 760000). BIDS NIRS channels.tsv wavelength_nominal, a REQUIRED column.

group.description: Electrode group, shaft, grid, or tracking system this channel belongs to. NWB ElectrodeGroup; BIDS Motion tracksys.

features.description: Open-ended per-channel features not captured by the typed fields.

sensorSpec.description: Physical placement of one sensor: an EEG electrode, an iEEG contact, a MEG coil, an fNIRS optode, a motion marker, or an anatomical landmark. Coordinates are signed integer nanometres in the frame named by the enclosing coordinateSystem.

uuid.description: Stable identifier within this record. Required because channels, anchors and spatial regions point at sensors.

name.description: Sensor name exactly as in the raw file.

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the sensor type definition node (typeDef of `sensor-type`).

type.description: Sensor type slug (fallback when typeUri unavailable). BIDS optodes.tsv type is REQUIRED and takes source or detector; the rest cover the electrode, coil, marker and landmark cases BIDS spreads across electrodes.tsv and coordsystem.json.

xNanometres.description: Signed X. BIDS electrodes.tsv x and optodes.tsv x, REQUIRED columns; NWB electrodes.x.

contactAreaSquareMicrometres.description: BIDS iEEG electrodes.tsv size, a REQUIRED column, square millimetres upstream. Load-bearing for current-density interpretation.

materialUri.description: AT-URI of the electrode material definition node (typeDef of `electrode-material`).

material.description: Material slug (fallback when materialUri unavailable). BIDS electrodes.tsv material, free text upstream, where Ag/AgCl already has three predictable spellings.

hemisphereUri.description: AT-URI of the hemisphere definition node.

hemisphere.description: Hemisphere slug (fallback when hemisphereUri unavailable). BIDS iEEG electrodes.tsv hemisphere.

group.description: Electrode group or shaft. NWB ElectrodeGroup, whose name, description, location and device are all required there.

anatomyRef.description: Grounded anatomical localization. NWB makes electrodes.location a required column and BIDS iEEG carries it free text; use source uberon. For iEEG this is a subject-specific claim about a subject-specific brain and inherits the participant's identifiability declaration.

features.description: Open-ended per-sensor features not captured by the typed fields.

coordinateSystem.description: The frame in which sensor, landmark, or volume coordinates are expressed. BIDS coordsystem.json, which requires a named system plus units and RECOMMENDS FiducialsCoordinates and AnatomicalLandmarkCoordinates. One def for all four use sites, so the four divergent lists the proposals carried collapse to one.

systemUri.description: AT-URI of the coordinate system definition node (typeDef of `coordinate-system`). Values MUST agree with pub.layers.defs#spatialEntity.crs.

system.description: Coordinate system slug (fallback when systemUri unavailable). Covers the BIDS EEG, MEG and iEEG coordinate system lists plus the stereotaxic spaces used for volumetric data.

unitUri.description: AT-URI of the coordinate unit definition node.

unit.description: Unit of the stored integer coordinates (fallback when unitUri unavailable). BIDS coordinate units are m, mm or cm, plus pixels for iEEG on a photograph; nanometre is the integer-safe encoding of all three.

spatialAxesUri.description: AT-URI of the axis convention definition node (typeDef of `spatial-axes`).

spatialAxes.description: Direction code naming the positive direction of X, Y, Z (fallback when spatialAxesUri unavailable). BIDS Motion SpatialAxes. Determines how every coordinate in the record is read, so a consumer that cannot resolve it MUST NOT assume a default.

referenceImageRef.description: AT-URI of a pub.layers.media.media of kind volume or image this frame is defined against. BIDS IntendedFor, a filesystem path upstream.

fiducials.description: Named landmark points defining the frame. BIDS FiducialsCoordinates and AnatomicalLandmarkCoordinates.

description.description: Free-text note about this coordinate frame.

namedPoint.description: A named point in the enclosing coordinate system, in that system's unit.

nameUri.description: AT-URI of the landmark definition node.

x.description: Signed X coordinate of the point, in the enclosing system's unit.

y.description: Signed Y coordinate of the point, in the enclosing system's unit.

z.description: Signed Z coordinate of the point, in the enclosing system's unit.

filterSpec.description: One filter applied to a recording. BIDS makes SoftwareFilters REQUIRED and HardwareFilters RECOMMENDED and types both as arbitrary nested JSON, so a consumer cannot today decide whether a recording is admissible for a given analysis without reading prose. Every parameter here is an integer in a named unit.

stageUri.description: AT-URI of the filter stage definition node.

stage.description: Where the filter was applied (fallback when stageUri unavailable). Distinguishes BIDS HardwareFilters from SoftwareFilters.

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the filter type definition node.

type.description: Filter type slug (fallback when typeUri unavailable).

lowCutoffMilliHz.description: High-pass cutoff of this filter stage, in millihertz.

highCutoffMilliHz.description: Low-pass cutoff of this filter stage, in millihertz.

centreMilliHz.description: Centre frequency, for notch and bandstop stages, in millihertz.

bandwidthMilliHz.description: Bandwidth of the stage, in millihertz.

designUri.description: AT-URI of the filter design definition node.

design.description: Filter design slug (fallback when designUri unavailable).

directionUri.description: AT-URI of the filter direction definition node.

direction.description: Whether the filter introduces phase shift (fallback when directionUri unavailable). Load-bearing for any latency claim about an ERP or evoked component.

software.description: Software that applied the filter, reusing the shared block rather than re-declaring name and version.

description.description: Free-text note about this filter stage.

eventCode.description: One trigger code and what it means. Grounds BIDS events.tsv trial_type, a bare string upstream, in a type definition node.

code.description: Integer value written on the trigger channel.

channel.description: The channel this code appears on, when the recording has several trigger lines.

label.description: Condition label as the experimenter spells it.

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the condition or event-type definition node, typically a pub.layers.ontology.typeDef.

knowledgeRef.description: External grounding, for instance a HED tag (source hed) or a Cognitive Atlas concept.

description.description: Free-text note about this trigger code.

eyeTrackingInfo.description: Composable eye-tracking metadata, carried alongside signalInfo. Screen geometry is deliberately absent: the same tracker at a different viewing distance yields different degrees of visual angle, so it is a property of stimulus presentation and lives on pub.layers.judgment.defs#presentationSpec.screen, which is where BIDS puts it (the StimulusPresentation object of the events sidecar).

recordedEyeUri.description: AT-URI of the recorded-eye definition node.

recordedEye.description: Which eye was recorded (fallback when recordedEyeUri unavailable). BIDS RecordedEye, REQUIRED for eye-tracking recordings.

sampleCoordinateSystemUri.description: AT-URI of the gaze coordinate system definition node.

sampleCoordinateSystem.description: What the x and y samples mean (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). BIDS SampleCoordinateSystem, REQUIRED. gaze-on-screen is the value that makes presentationSpec.screen mandatory.

sampleCoordinateUnitUri.description: AT-URI of the gaze sample unit definition node.

sampleCoordinateUnit.description: Unit of the gaze samples (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). BIDS SampleCoordinateUnits.

methodUri.description: AT-URI of the eye-tracking method definition node.

method.description: Tracking method slug (fallback when methodUri unavailable). BIDS EyeTrackingMethod, whose documented values include P-CR, DPI and EOG.

pupilFitMethodUri.description: AT-URI of the pupil fit method definition node.

pupilFitMethod.description: BIDS PupilFitMethod (fallback when the Uri is unavailable).

calibrationTypeUri.description: AT-URI of the calibration grid definition node.

calibrationType.description: BIDS CalibrationType (fallback when the Uri is unavailable), whose examples are H3 and HV9.

averageCalibrationErrorMicrodegrees.description: BIDS AverageCalibrationError. Microdegrees because typical values are fractions of a degree.

eventDetectionUri.description: AT-URI of the fixation and saccade detection algorithm definition node.

eventDetection.description: Algorithm used to derive fixations and saccades (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). Absent means the trace is raw and no events were derived.

imageInfo.description: Composable still-image metadata. Added because 0.8.0 has no image block at all, so a photograph's width and height had to borrow videoInfo, whose own description says it is for video content.

dpi.description: Resolution in dots per inch, when the image derives from a physical original.

colorSpaceUri.description: AT-URI of the colour space definition node.

colorSpace.description: Colour space slug (fallback when colorSpaceUri unavailable). Paired here even though the sibling videoInfo.colorSpace is not, since a new field should not inherit an existing wart.

codec.description: Image codec identifier (jpeg, png, webp, jp2, tiff-lzw). Wire-format code, exempt from pairing.

captureDevice.description: Camera or scanner, structured rather than concatenated into a format string.

motionInfo.description: Composable motion-capture and articulography metadata: optical marker systems, inertial suits, electromagnetic articulography, ultrasound tongue imaging, and body or hand pose streams. Follows BIDS Motion, in which a tracking system is a grouping level below the session, so one session routinely carries several media records at different rates. A motion stream also carries signalInfo, because in BIDS Motion a mocap channel is typed POS, ORNT, VEL, ACCEL, GYRO, MAGN, ANGACCEL or JNTANG, that is, it is a sampled signal.

trackingSystem.description: The pub.layers.acquisition.defs#run or session stream grouping this system, as an objectRef. BIDS Motion tracksys entity, a bare label upstream.

formatUri.description: AT-URI of the motion container format definition node.

format.description: Container format slug (fallback when formatUri unavailable). Wire-format code.

trackedPointCount.description: Number of tracked points, markers, or joints.

rotationRuleUri.description: AT-URI of the rotation handedness definition node.

rotationRule.description: BIDS Motion RotationRule (fallback when the Uri is unavailable).

rotationOrderUri.description: AT-URI of the rotation order definition node.

rotationOrder.description: BIDS Motion RotationOrder (fallback when the Uri is unavailable).

skeletonUri.description: AT-URI of the skeleton or marker-set definition node (typeDef of `skeleton`), which is where joint identity, joint order and joint topology are DEFINED. This is why no pose anchor is needed: the channels carry the numbers, this carries their meaning.

skeleton.description: Skeleton or marker-set slug (fallback when skeletonUri unavailable).

coordinateSystem.description: Carries spatialAxes; a motion stream must not define a second axis vocabulary.

volumeInfo.description: Composable metadata for volumetric imaging: fMRI runs, structural scans, and derived masks or parcellations. Volumes almost always exceed the blob cap, so externalUri plus contentDigest is the normal carriage rather than the exception.

volumeKindUri.description: AT-URI of the volume kind definition node.

volumeKind.description: Volume kind slug (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). BIDS suffix plus datatype.

formatUri.description: AT-URI of the volume container format definition node.

format.description: Container format slug (fallback when formatUri unavailable). Wire-format code.

voxelSizeXNanometres.description: Voxel edge length along X, in nanometres.

voxelSizeYNanometres.description: Voxel edge length along Y, in nanometres.

voxelSizeZNanometres.description: Voxel edge length along Z, in nanometres.

sliceTimingNanos.description: Per-slice acquisition offsets within one TR. BIDS SliceTiming.

coordinateSystem.description: Stereotaxic frame the voxel grid is expressed against.

syncInfo.description: How one media stream aligns to a session's shared time base. This is what makes multimodal Layers possible: the 0.8.0 chain is annotationLayer.expression (single, REQUIRED) to expression.mediaRef (single), so a session of two cameras, a lapel microphone, an EEG cap and an eye tracker is unrepresentable, and parentMediaRef with startOffsetMs expresses excerpt-of, a different relation.

sessionRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.acquisition.session whose clock this stream is expressed against.

offsetNanos.description: Signed offset from session time zero to this stream's first sample. Session-relative, never UTC-epoch. Negative when the stream began before the origin, which is normal for a continuously running amplifier and which BIDS StartTime explicitly permits.

clockSourceUri.description: AT-URI of the synchronization method definition node (typeDef of `sync-method`).

clockSource.description: How alignment was established (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). A consumer needs it to know how far to trust a cross-stream anchor: a hardware trigger and a clapperboard differ by three orders of magnitude.

syncChannel.description: The channel carrying the shared sync signal, when clockSource is shared-trigger.

driftPartsPerBillion.description: Signed measured drift against the session master. Independent oscillators diverge measurably over an hour, and zero is a claim rather than a safe default.

syncUncertaintyNanos.description: Worst-case alignment error. Bounds how finely a cross-stream anchor may honestly be read.
